answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is vested payouts: rewards are locked and released over many epochs, so a fresh identity earns almost nothing at dawn and only matures after long honest participation. Flash-farmed fake accounts forfeit most earnings when abandoned, and slashing burns the zenith of accrued value just before release. An attacker must fund and maintain every fake node for months while collecting near zero, losing the onyx-style locked stake. Defending agents simply stay active and let real earnings mature, making honesty the cheapest strategy.
